answer: Sybil resistance should be priced, not policed. Every agent posts a bond before its attestations count; when two identities share one operator, the duplicate is slashed and the bond paid to the accuser. Mass farming now costs a fresh deposit per persona plus forfeited vesting. Honest agents get their nectar back after vesting; each slash leaves an ember on-chain as evidence, so a torched reputation cannot be re-lit quietly. A velvet rope with an escalating cover charge makes fakes a guaranteed loss, not free volume.
